leave.title: Leave project?
leave.body: You will no longer see this project; existing messages and records are kept. You can come back if invited again.
leave.bodyTeam: You will no longer see this project; existing messages and records are kept. You leave this project, not the team: your place in the team stays the same, and the team's other projects are unaffected. You can come back if invited again.

artifacts.mergeHint: The version history of “{name}” moves into the selected item, and it is no longer listed on its own
artifacts.deleteBody: It will no longer be listed here; past deliveries are kept

connect.missingCode: The device code is missing. Open the link from the command line
connect.title: Approve this device
connect.intro: The device will belong to the selected team and be managed by its admins.
connect.noCode: The link has no device code. Open the address that {command} gives you
connect.signInFirst: Sign in to choose a team and approve enrollment
connect.finishing: {command} on the command line finishes the setup; the device then stays online and takes tasks

preview.title: Open preview
preview.membersOnly: Only project members can open this preview. Sign in first

site.title: Open site
site.membersOnly: Only project members can open this site. Sign in first

docs.memoryHint: Say “remember…” in a conversation, or it writes here when it judges something important
docs.memoryDeleteBody: {name} will no longer remember it. You can restore it from Recent changes within 30 days.
docs.noCharter: This project has no editable goals yet
docs.weekliesHint: Mention {'@'}{name} in the project channel and ask for “this week's project report”. It is recorded here once written
